fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the access point during nighttime or low-visibility conditions.
• Trim trees and shrubs along both sides of the driveway to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Keep overhead branches along the driveway trimmed to allow fire apparatus and tall emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Designate and mark a flat, stable turnaround area near the residence so arriving apparatus can reposition without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Keep the turnaround area clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and stored materials at all times.
• Thin dense vegetation adjacent to the driveway to allow responders on foot to move alongside vehicles if needed.
• Clear a staging area near the detached structure large enough for at least one emergency vehicle to park and operate.
• Keep a direct walking path between the main residence and the detached structure clear of obstructions for responder movement between the two buildings.
• Post the property address visibly at the road and again near the residence to help responders confirm location after traveling the full driveway length.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or touching the house on all sides.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to create open gaps between tree canopies and the roofline.
• Remove shrubs and brush growing in the immediate area around the base of the structure.
• Cut grass around the structure and keep it short throughout the dry season.
• Clear brush and overhanging branches along both sides of the driveway for its full length.
• Trim tree branches that hang over the driveway to allow emergency vehicles to pass through without obstruction.
• Remove shrubs and tall grass growing along the driveway edges that could carry fire toward the structure.
• Keep the area between scattered trees and the structure open and free of shrubs and tall grass.
• Thin brush in the open terrain surrounding the structure to reduce the amount of vegetation connecting the surrounding area to the house.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to emergency responders approaching from the main road.
• Keep the single access route clear of fallen branches, overgrown vegetation, and debris at all times.
• Separate shrub clusters from one another near the structure by removing individual plants to break up continuous patches of vegetation.
• Remove dead or dry grass and plant material from the open green space immediately surrounding the structure.
